messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired -> service=infra-nginx-504, dedupe_group=host-uptime, severity=high, incidents=3

alex: acked on PagerDuty. I'm on it. pinged maya for infra context.

maya: seeing a spike in 504s from the EU edge pool, started ~02:12 UTC. Rate ~120/minute. Could be autoscaler flapping.

jon: are these all the same host group? alert says dedupe_group=host-uptime but I'm seeing multiple upstream 502/504 patterns too.

maya: yes, most from edge-eu-*, but also a smattering in us-west.

lee: pd-bot shows two escalations already. oncall-night is currently unack, alex you good to hold until handoff in 12m?

alex: I can hold, but if paging doesn't stop we'll need to silence. Whoever can add a suppression for the group do it.

jon: trying to correlate with deploys — nothing in prod-deploys at that window. metrics: ingress latency and backend 5xx both up.

maya: quick customer impact check: auth service gets 10% higher 5xx rate; a few high-volume customers reported errors via Support channel.

lee: support data: ~2% of active sessions failing platform-wide for the last 10m. Could be noticeable for customers with streaming workloads.

alex: temp mitigation: enable alertmanager grouping/silence for dedupe_group=host-uptime for 15m, then re-evaluate. Also enable automatic fallback to small model on heavy requests? (jk)

jon: I'll create the silence. If it keeps firing we need to tune dedupe rules; paging storm due to slight flapping.

jon: creating silence via alertmanager API now

jon: ```
curl -XPOST http://alertmanager.internal/api/v2/silences -d '{\n  "matchers":[{"name":"dedupe_group","value":"host-uptime","isRegex":false}],\n  "startsAt":"2026-03-14T02:20:00Z",\n  "endsAt":"2026-03-14T02:35:00Z",\n  "createdBy":"jon",\n  "comment":"Temporary suppression for paging storm, investigating root cause"\n}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```

incident-bot: Silence created id=SilenceID-9a7f, matches=dedupe_group=host-uptime, expires=2026-03-14T02:35:00Z

maya: thanks. I'm rerouting a few suspect nodes out of the NLB rotation to see if error rate drops.

alex: oncall-night I've left notes in the incident channel. Handing off in ~8m. If paging resumes please escalate to infra-sre.

oncall-night: @alex ack, I see the handoff. I'll monitor and take over if needed.

lee: pd-bot: was the original page a flood (many similar alerts) or genuine multi-signal issue? we should decide dedupe threshold.

pd-bot: page reason: alertmanager grouped 47 alerts in 3m for infra-nginx-504; escalation due to repeat occurrences after 2 acks.

jon: initial post-silence metrics: ingress 5xx down ~60% in the suppressed group after removing two suspicious nodes.

maya: customer reports dropping too. Looks like bad kernel/network offload cfg on those nodes. I'm rolling a kernel fix and will cordon similar nodes.

alex: good. Plan: 1) keep silence for remaining 10m 2) finish cordon + kernel fix 3) run targeted test load 4) remove silence and watch alerts

lee: logging note: create a brief incident ticket and tag with "paging-storm" and link this thread + silence id.

jon: ticket created INC-20260314-72, linked to SilenceID-9a7f and pd incidents.

oncall-night: I've got monitoring dashboards open, will watch for re-fires and take over if anything pops after handoff.

alex: handing off now — badge: alex -> oncall-night. Leaving runbook links and steps in the ticket.

maya: root cause looks like incorrect RK-ATK offload that survived a recent image bake. Patch and redeploy to the bad pool.

lee: postmortem action: adjust alertmanager dedupe to group by (region, service) rather than host-uptime alone; reduce pager threshold for cross-region spikes.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: all active pages resolved for service=infra-nginx-504. silence=SilenceID-9a7f expired or removed.

oncall-night: confirmed resolved from my side. I'll keep eyes for 30m and then close ticket if stable.

alex: nice work team. remember to add a blameless postmortem and update alerting docs for suppression tuning.

maya: adding notes to the postmortem doc and the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/paging-storm

lee: done. closing thread here. :white_check_mark:
